title: The Trading Desk Perspective: Xheni Brahaxhija on Access, Mentorship & Success
summary: What does it really take to build a successful career on a trading desk? Xheni Brahaxhija shares her journey from compliance to front-office trading while discussing the critical role of access, mentorship, sponsorship, and leadership in creating opportunities and helping more women thrive in financial markets.
